items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: and played Charlie Parker — and sound and all, everything that was Charlie Parker this kid played.

ctx.x: Right. What was he doing at five years old?

You’ve got to really think that that’s — and we saw a kid in New Jersey. He was about nine years old. And we were playing on the pier. And he was playing this — his mother and father brought him up to our group, “Our son can play the alto sax. Can he sit in with you?” And we say, “Yeah.” We always welcome. So he took his sax horn out of his case and put the mouthpiece on and I said, “What would you like to play?” He said, “Now Is The Time.” We said, “Okay, you set it.” He set it [scats] — and played Charlie…
And to watch his attitude was something. Because —
